description: Third-party interoperability evidence vectors: live transport-level interoperability between UTA and external agent-trust gateways, captured from real exchanges. These are evidence artifacts, not scored cards — the fixed vectors in ../_index.json remain the scored set, unchanged byte-for-byte.

vectors.reason: transport-level interoperability with composed verdicts: AgentBouncer envelope verified (signature valid, replay checked); UTA verdict PASS (8/8 controls + caps match, network.egress=allowlist)
vectors.transport: RFC 9421 signed request; x-uta-trust covered component
vectors.notes: AgentBouncer verifies the envelope incl. covered x-uta-trust header; it does not parse the ATC or enforce its capabilities (per vendor clarification 2026-10-01). UTA verdict produced independently by the MarketNow verifier.

vectors.reason: transport-level interoperability with composed verdicts: AgentBouncer envelope verified (signature valid, replay checked); UTA verdict POLICY_FAIL (action mcp:tools/call requires network.egress=allowlist, card grants none) — denial attributable to trust-policy, not transport
vectors.transport: RFC 9421 signed request; x-uta-trust covered component

uta_verdict.reason: action mcp:tools/call requires network.egress=allowlist, card grants none

vectors.notes: Identical to vector agentbouncer-transport-allowed except network.egress=none (and card_id/timestamps/signature). Both cards pass 8/8 ATC controls; the only differential variable is the caps entry.

publication_record.user_approval: 2026-10-03 — explicit publish instruction after personal review
pre_publication_verifications: V1 crypto — APROBADA: SHA-256(JCS canónico con signature='' y hash='') == signed_payload_hash en ambas tarjetas; firma Ed25519 de la CA (issuer.ca_public_key) válida sobre los mismos bytes; subject_key != ca_key; ventana de validez cubre el test

V2 isolation/consistency — APROBADA (10/10): tarjetas difieren SOLO en card_id, timestamps (1ms secuencial), egress (allowlist vs none) y firma+hash re-firmada; veredictos consistentes con caps; x-uta-trust cubierto por Signature-Input (RFC 9421) en ambos paths; transporte válido en ambos (verified=true, signature=valid)

V3 wording/claims — APROBADA (10/10): cada claim verificado contra trazas + clarificación del vendor (2026-10-01: transport-level interoperability, NOT end-to-end UTA policy enforcement by AgentBouncer)
